canonical_revision_note: Deliberately absent. DO-013 owns revision provenance; a test asserts no presentation contract declares canonical_revision_id.

documented_exceptions.cause: core.autocrlf=true with no .gitattributes rewrites the trailing byte of resources/mvp2/do008_bundle/zone_semantics.json to CRLF
msys2 Python cp1252 stdout cannot encode U+2192 in scripts/verify_mvp1_release_lineage.py

linux_wsl.platform: WSL Ubuntu 24.04, Python 3.12.3, clean clone at ~/mas-do012
linux_wsl.full_pytest_not_run_reason: The distribution's python3 ships without pip and without ensurepip (Debian moves them into python3-venv/python3-pip). Installing them, or starting Docker Desktop, would have modified the developer host, which was not authorized. The dependency-free checks above cover exactly the two Windows exceptions; the full Linux suite is delegated to GitHub Actions, which the Dev Order names as authoritative.

github_actions.note: Authoritative Linux certification. All three gates green on ubuntu-latest, including the full pytest suite. This independently confirms that both Windows failures are checkout/console environment artifacts rather than repository defects: the same tests pass here.

ci_coverage_gap.note: Expanding CI is release-infrastructure scope. Recorded here and in the release report for a later Dev Order rather than closed inside this tranche.

browser_smoke.driver: headless Chromium via the agent's browser automation tooling

defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.defect: The follower re-issued hard seeks against a media element that cannot seek
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.evidence: The bundled DO-011 clip reports seekable=[0,0] with buffered=[0,3] and readyState=4
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.fix: Check the element's seekable ranges before correcting; report DEGRADED once instead

defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.defect: The 'Sync to lesson' label rendered light-on-light and was invisible
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.evidence: Teaching Media panel background is Canvas-based while the app sets near-white text
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_run.fix: The sync control uses the same system-color basis as the panel it sits in

import_graph.media_dependency_note: Intentional and one-directional: the sidecar carries MediaTimelineBindingV1. presentation never imports media, so there is no cycle.

handoff_corrections.assumption: Educational ISOLATE_PASSAGE already drove the practice loop
handoff_corrections.reality: practice_actions.js emitted a status string and app.js set a visual focus range; nothing called Transport.setLoop from an Educational action
handoff_corrections.resolution: DO-012 adds the presentation adapter. Educational engine code is unchanged and its digests are pinned.

handoff_corrections.reality: Musical Core owns ticks_to_seconds; the browser only consumed precomputed onset_seconds
handoff_corrections.resolution: Python-authored anchor table exported beside each projection; the browser interpolates within it. No second tick converter in JavaScript.

handoff_corrections.assumption: The repository uses static projection exports only
handoff_corrections.resolution: Bindings ride the existing media payload; anchors ride the static projection export. Two sources, joined in presentation.
